title: Wielopojazdowy stress lab i wspólne sterowanie
question: Jak skaluje się pełny pojazd JV, jego kontakty i wybrany model koła wraz z liczbą jednocześnie aktywnych aut?
hypothesis: Broadcast input lub deterministyczny autopilot pozwoli odtworzyć ten sam workload dla 1/4/8/16/32 pojazdów, ujawniając koszt kontaktów, narożników i przyszłej podatności bez mieszania go z AI.

locked_factors.vehicle_revision: one immutable full JV config per campaign
locked_factors.wheel_model: one selected wheel/contact model per campaign
locked_factors.input_trace: identical broadcast trace or deterministic autopilot seed
locked_factors.terrain: fixed plate or fixed obstacle field

confounds: Changing vehicle count and wheel model in the same campaign would mix scale with model cost.
Manual driving creates a different workload for every run.
Rendering and camera visibility can dominate frame time and hide physics scaling.
Overlapping spawns create startup explosions rather than a representative vehicle workload.
Sleeping vehicles would make nominal fleet size differ from active fleet size.

levels.purpose: Measure pure vehicle/contact scaling with deterministic broadcast input.
levels.entry_gate: Single vehicle reproduces the current validator and no vehicles overlap at spawn.
levels.exit_gate: Stable mean/p95/p99 timing and contact counts for 1/4/8/16/32 vehicles.

levels.purpose: Exercise seams, hull edges and difficult contact paths at fleet scale.
levels.entry_gate: S1 timing is repeatable and per-vehicle workload is understood.
levels.exit_gate: No crashes/non-finite states; expensive contact-path incidence and p99 cost are recorded.

levels.purpose: Let Jozz control all cars together or take over one while preserving the measured scenario.
levels.entry_gate: Headless workload and controls are deterministic.
levels.exit_gate: Interactive mode reproduces the same spawn/input contract and exposes live fleet telemetry.

promotion_rules: Wheel/contact model comparisons are separate campaigns using the same fleet-count matrix.
S2 begins only after S1 establishes a stable cost baseline.
Interactive S3 is a product/tooling layer, not evidence unless it replays the deterministic trace.
A fleet size that exceeds the frame budget remains a valid measured result, not a failed experiment.
manual_gates: Jozz can broadcast throttle/steer/brake to all vehicles.
Jozz can select and take over one vehicle without changing the others' deterministic controller.
The lab visibly reports active fleet size, physics p95/p99 and contact pressure instead of only FPS.
blockers: Finish WHEEL-SOFT-03A so fleet campaigns can lock an explicit wheel-contact model.
Refactor vehicle creation into a reusable fleet-safe spawn API.
Add deterministic broadcast input trace and minimal autopilot independent of gameplay AI.
Expose per-step physics/contact counters in a machine-readable headless result.
Separate headless validation from GUI/NFD/GTK dependencies in CMake.
